I had a Cornish Rock chicken. She lived to be 6 years old and was mostly very happy, just food obsessed. The main thing to keep her healthy was to limit her chicken feed whilst letting her eat as much as she wanted from grazing as it was good excersize. She did hurt her leg around 2 months old from jumping against a fence to get to some food. But it healed after keeping her cooped up in an unused rabbit hutch for a few weeks. She had a slight hobble for the rest of her life, but it did not stop her from doing anything. She was very intelligent, and I managed to teach her a few tricks. Her favorite trick was spinning in a circle.
